subject: GreenBank - request to validate degraded availability window and credit eligibility
messages:
From: Alyssa Meyers <alyssa@greenbank.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean@redwood.com>
Cc: ops@greenbank.com
Date: 2027-05-12T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Intermittent 5xx + slow responses this morning - please validate window and credit eligibility

Sean —

We saw a spike of 5xx responses and request timeouts across our production traffic between ~08:45 and ~09:18 PDT this morning. Our SRE dashboards recorded sustained error rates (~4.8% of requests) and a number of replayed transactions failed. This impacted our payments path (tokenize->confirm) and resulted in several customer-facing timeouts.

Can Redwood confirm whether this maps to a service degradation on your side and share the exact outage window you can verify? GreenBank will need that window, evidence for impact, and an estimate of potential SLA credit eligibility to begin an internal customer communications plan.

We've attached a small sampling of our client-side traces and a connection-level log bundle (greenbank_request_logs_20270512.zip). Please let me know if you need anything else.

We are standing by for an expedited confirmation — this is P1 for us.

Thanks,
Alyssa
Alyssa Meyers
Senior Platform Ops, GreenBank
alyssa@greenbank.com

From: Sean Gallagher <sean@redwood.com>
To: Alyssa Meyers <alyssa@greenbank.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-12T09:28:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Intermittent 5xx + slow responses this morning - please validate window and credit eligibility

Hi Alyssa —

Thanks for the heads up and for sending logs. I'm very sorry for the disruption. We're triaging now. Initial ask: can you confirm whether the failures you saw were primarily 503/504 or 5xx with a body? That helps us narrow between routing vs model runtime failures.

I'll route this to our on-call infra team and ask for an early timeline. Rishi — can you pick this up and validate whether any capacity events or autoscaling anomalies overlapped 08:30-09:30 PDT? Evelyn/Karthik, please standby for evidence pull and a candidate credit calculation.

I will follow up within 45 minutes with a preliminary window and next steps.

Best,
Sean
Sean Gallagher
Enterprise Success, Redwood Inference
sean@redwood.com
(415) 555-0194

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Alyssa Meyers <alyssa@greenbank.com>
Date: 2027-05-12T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Intermittent 5xx + slow responses this morning - please validate window and credit eligibility

On Thu, May 12, 2027 at 09:28 AM Sean Gallagher <sean@redwood.com> wrote:
> Hi Alyssa —
>
> Thanks for the heads up and for sending logs. I'm very sorry for the disruption. We're triaging now.

Folks — quick status from infra triage: we observed an elevated tail latency and increased 503 responses between 08:42:12 and 09:15:37 PDT in the serving cluster assigned to GreenBank's tenant. Root cause appears to be a mis-tuned autoscaling policy combined with a KV-cache pressure event on a subset of shards; that caused a backlog of requests while the fleet scaled. No model upload or code deploys in that window.

Steps taken:
- Scaled additional inference workers and cleared the KV cache hot-paths at ~09:05 PDT, which reduced the 503 rate; full recovery by ~09:16 PDT.
- We pulled runtime logs and sample host metrics; initial signals show CPU/memory within expected ranges on healthy hosts post-scale.

Action items:
1) We will produce an incident timeline with host-level metrics and the autoscaler decision trace (ETA for draft RCA: EOD tomorrow).
2) Evelyn/Karthik, please produce a candidate SLA credit calc per the GreenBank contract clauses for availability for the window 2027-05-12T08:42:12-2027-05-12T09:15:37 PDT.
3) Sean — suggest offering a provisional pro-rated credit while we complete full evidence verification; we can finalize the amount after log correlation.

I'll attach the first-pass host timeline to the internal folder.

-Rishi

From: Sean Gallagher <sean@redwood.com>
To: Alyssa Meyers <alyssa@greenbank.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-12T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Intermittent 5xx + slow responses this morning - please validate window and credit eligibility

Alyssa —

Thanks again for the quick report and the logs. Short update: our infra team has identified an elevated 503/error window between 08:42:12 and 09:15:37 PDT that maps to your tenant's serving pool. Root cause appears to be autoscaler behavior compounded by a cache pressure event on a subset of shards.

Next steps from Redwood:
- We'll deliver a short timeline (host metrics + autoscaler decision trace) within 24 hours.
- We'll produce a candidate SLA credit calculation by end of day tomorrow after correlation with your traces.
- As a gesture while we validate, Redwood will provisionally apply a one-time pro-rated credit against May usage that we can adjust if evidence changes. This provisional credit is not a final admission of liability; final credit will be determined per the SLA after we finish the verification.

Can you confirm you are comfortable with a provisional pro-rated credit (we'll show the calculation), and whether you want the credit applied as an invoice credit or account balance?

I'll keep you updated and share the RCA draft once Rishi/Evelyn have it.

Best,
Sean

On Thu, May 12, 2027 at 10:05 AM Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com> wrote:
> Folks — quick status from infra triage...

From: Alyssa Meyers <alyssa@greenbank.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean@redwood.com>
Cc: ops@greenbank.com
Date: 2027-05-13T17:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Intermittent 5xx + slow responses this morning - please validate window and credit eligibility

Sean —

Thanks for the quick investigation and the offer of a provisional credit. GreenBank confirms the observed client-side failure population is consistent with 503/504 timeouts in the 08:42–09:16 PDT range; your window aligns with our telemetry.

We are OK with a provisional pro-rated credit applied to our May invoice as an account balance; please include the exact calculation and the evidence bundle in the RCA. We also need the full postmortem (automated traces + host metrics + autoscaler decision logs) for our compliance audit — can you include the autoscaler decision IDs and the node IDs affected?

Please share draft RCA when available; GreenBank would prefer the final postmortem within 72 hours if possible.

Appreciate the responsiveness — looking forward to the evidence set.

Regards,
Alyssa
